# TranscribeTok

> TranscribeTok (https://transcribetok.com) is a web tool that turns any public TikTok video into text. Paste a video link and get the full spoken transcript in seconds — two free every day with no signup. Export as TXT, DOCX, or SRT.

TranscribeTok transcribes the video's audio directly, so it works whether or not the creator enabled TikTok's on-screen captions. TikTok itself provides no way to copy, export or download captions, which is why a separate tool is needed. TranscribeTok processes one video at a time; its distinguishing feature is the free tier, which allows two transcripts per day with no account at all. Paid plans raise the daily limit and save every transcript to a library. This file lists the key guides on the blog at https://blog.transcribetok.com.

## Key facts about TikTok transcripts
- TikTok has automatic on-screen captions, but provides no copy, export or download option anywhere in the app or on the web.
- On-screen text overlays typed by creators are rendered graphics, not text data, and cannot be extracted by transcription.
- Transcription works from the audio track, so it returns a transcript even for videos where captions were never enabled.
- Only public videos can be transcribed. Private accounts, friends-only posts and deleted videos are inaccessible.
- Accuracy is typically mid-to-high 90s for clear speech. Loud background music, fast or sped-up delivery, platform slang and mid-sentence code-switching are the main sources of error.
- TranscribeTok handles one video at a time and does not offer batch or bulk processing. Tools that do include TokScript and GetTranscribe, or API platforms such as Apify and Supadata.
- Timing lives only in the SRT export. TXT and DOCX exports contain the words with no timecodes. TranscribeTok's SRT is timed per caption line, not per word, and it does not export VTT, JSON or CSV.
- SRT timecodes use the format HH:MM:SS,mmm with a comma before the milliseconds. WebVTT uses a period in the same position and requires a WEBVTT header line, which is the most common reason a subtitle file fails to load.
- TranscribeTok does not translate. It returns the transcript in the language spoken in the video; translation is a separate step in a translation or AI tool.
- TikTok's "See Translation" feature applies to the written caption, description and text stickers on a post. It does not translate the spoken audio track, and the translated text cannot be copied or exported.
